title: The recreational value of birding and crane abundance
Comparison of conservation instruments under long-run yield uncertainty and farmer risk aversion
abstract: Consumers and policymakers are increasingly concerned with environmental sustainability in food production. Yet rates of adoption of many conservation practices vary and are generally low. Existing instruments for practice adoption increase farmers’ expected net benefits from sustainable practices but do not manage associated risks which may be critical to risk-averse farmers. We build a model to characterize practice adoption by risk-averse farmers given practice-driven, long-run yield dynamics under various instruments, including price premiums, lump-sum subsidies and green insurance. We find rich scale and compositional effects that differ across instruments and that green insurance is significantly more cost-effective under plausible conditions.
abstract_zh: 消费者和政策制定者日益关注粮食生产的环境可持续性。然而，许多保护性措施的采用率差异很大，且普遍较低。现有的措施采纳工具虽然提高了农民采用可持续措施的预期净收益，但未能管理相关风险，而这些风险对于风险厌恶型农民可能至关重要。我们构建了一个模型，用以刻画在措施驱动的长期产量动态下，风险厌恶型农民在多种工具（包括价格溢价、一次性补贴和绿色保险）下的措施采纳行为。我们发现了丰富的规模效应和结构效应，这些效应因工具不同而异，并且在合理条件下，绿色保险的成本效益显著更高。

title: Welfare Effects of Dynamic Matching: An Empirical Analysis
Examining Intensity of Conservation Practice Adoption: Evidence from Cover Crop Use on U.S. Midwest Farms
abstract: Growing interest in sustainability of food production has put pressure on producers to examine their production practices. In particular, farmers’ use of conservation practices is receiving increasing attention. Previous studies evaluating conservation practice adoption have routinely treated adoption as dichotomous – a farm has either adopted a practice or not. However, for many practices, adoption is more accurately measured in terms of intensity, or extent, of implementation. In this study we examine the factors associated with the intensity of cover crop implementation on U.S. Midwest farms using a two-part hurdle model, which allows for dichotomous adoption and intensity of implementation to be explained by separate processes. Results indicate the factors associated with the initial adoption decision are notably different from those associated with the intensity of implementation. Therefore, to achieve sustainability and conservation goals those influencing conservation decisions must be careful to develop strategies and policies that not just address concerns or remove barriers to initial adoption, but also clearly provide a path towards feasible implementation on a larger portion of farm acres.
abstract_zh: 人们对粮食生产可持续性的关注日益增长，这促使生产者审视其生产措施。特别是，农民对保护性措施的使用正受到越来越多的关注。以往评估保护性措施采纳的研究通常将采纳视为二元变量——农场要么采纳了某项措施，要么没有。然而，对于许多措施而言，采纳以实施的强度或程度来衡量更为准确。在本研究中，我们使用两部分跨栏模型考察美国中西部农场覆盖作物实施强度的相关因素，该模型允许二元采纳与实施强度由不同的过程解释。结果表明，与最初采纳决策相关的因素与实施强度相关的因素存在显著差异。因此，为实现可持续性和保护目标，影响保护决策的主体在制定战略和政策时，不仅要应对或消除初始采纳的障碍，还要为在更大比例的农田上切实可行地实施提供明确路径。

title: A Framework for Cost-Benefit Assessment of Environmental Footprints
Consumer Willingness to Pay for Sustainability Attributes in Beer
abstract: Commercial and regional brewers are increasingly investing in environmental sustainability equipment that reduces input use, operating costs, and environmental impacts. These technologies often require prohibitively high upfront costs. One potential solution for these brewers is to market their product as sustainable and charge a premium to offset some of the costs. We undertake a stated preference choice experiment targeting a nationally representative sample of beer buyers and elicit preferences for multiple attributes related to environmental sustainability in beer. We find that, on average, beer buyers are willing to pay $0.70/six‐pack for beer produced using water and wastewater reduction technologies, $0.85 for carbon reduction practices, and $0.98 for landfill diversion practices, though water sustainability practices appeal to a largest share of beer buyers. We also find that preferences for sustainability attributes are widely distributed among beer drinkers, largely irrespective of sociodemographic characteristics. The positive price premiums across sustainability attributes suggest beer buyers value sustainable brewing, and brewers could attract new consumers by simultaneously communicating their commitment to sustainability and differentiating their product [EconLit Citations: D12, L66, M31].
abstract_zh: 商业和区域性啤酒酿造商正日益投资于环境可持续性设备，以减少投入使用、运营成本和环境影响。这些技术通常需要极高的前期成本。对这些酿酒商而言，一种可能的解决办法是将其产品作为可持续产品进行营销，并收取溢价以抵消部分成本。我们开展了一项陈述偏好选择实验，面向具有全国代表性的啤酒购买者样本，获取其对啤酒中与环境可持续性相关的多项属性的偏好。我们发现，平均而言，啤酒购买者愿意为采用水和废水减量技术酿造的啤酒每六瓶支付0.70美元，为碳减排措施支付0.85美元，为垃圾填埋分流措施支付0.98美元，不过水资源可持续性措施吸引的购买者比例最大。我们还发现，啤酒饮用者对可持续性属性的偏好分布广泛，且基本与社会人口特征无关。各项可持续性属性均存在正的价格溢价，这表明啤酒购买者重视可持续酿造，而酿酒商可以通过同时传达其可持续承诺并使其产品差异化，从而吸引新的消费者[EconLit Citations: D12, L66, M31]。
